Loopback HTTP transport supports flat typed text/reference/simple commands only; observation payload, intake creation endpoint, and read endpoints are not wired.
HTTP tests use synthetic OIDC identity source and synthetic clinical evidence; no production issuer, session revocation, MFA or consent authority integrated.
No production KMS, key rotation, secrets policy, encryption backup restore or crypto destruction verified.
0 of 261 screens clinically accepted; 0 of 40 modules certified; no hospital pilot/clinical sign-off.
No deployed browser/device builds, full responsive clinical workflow evidence or accessibility acceptance.
